principles: Route availability, case status and deadline status are independent dimensions.
Institutional responses change only the route instance and request to which they relate.
Every case-status event must cite a case evidence artifact.
Every general route definition must cite current legal or procedural authority.
A negative search, referral, acknowledgement, fee quote or temporary access problem is not automatically a formal refusal or an exhausted route.
Do not infer motive, wrongdoing, concealment or fraud from an administrative pattern.
Raw correspondence and personal data remain private; public material must be a reviewed derivative.

route_availability.description: A route appears to exist and is applicable on the verified facts.
A route may apply, but one or more legal, factual, standing or procedural prerequisites require verification.
A cited rule or verified decision establishes that this route does not apply.
The route's existence or applicability has not yet been checked against a current primary source.

case_status.description: Sent, with no acknowledgement yet evidenced.
A form, ID check, map, proof of entitlement or other prerequisite is outstanding.
Acknowledged or accepted for processing; substantive response outstanding.
The step produced a verifiable output and its acceptance criteria are met.
The defined route instance has reached its evidenced end point; the reason and source are mandatory.
A relevant deadline appears to have expired; solicitor verification is mandatory before asserting legal effect.
A specific fee or charge has been quoted; amount and basis are recorded separately.
A formal refusal/decision notice has been received and its stated basis is recorded.
The route remains available or conditional, but is deliberately not pursued until an owner decision, authority or spend approval is recorded. This does not mean the route is unavailable or exhausted.
A documented application or activity is underway.
A review decision has been received.
The review is accepted or acknowledged; outcome outstanding.
A review/representations request has been sent.
A documented legal or factual reason establishes that the defined route does not apply.
The body states that the information is not held; scope and search basis remain separately recorded.
The reply points to another route, archive or holder.
A complaint to an external regulator or ombudsman is in progress.
A bounded search was completed and no matching records were identified within its stated scope.
A service, collection or access route is temporarily unavailable.
A tribunal or court application/appeal is in progress.
The available sources do not support a reliable classification.
No application or step has been evidenced.
The applicant withdrew the defined request or step.

old_state_mapping.note: Old open means listed/open in the catalogue; does not prove case-specific legal availability.
Inspect source to distinguish acknowledgement, prerequisite, statutory clock and service target.
Do not mark complete until output and acceptance criteria are evidenced.
May mean unavailable, inapplicable or deliberately not pursued; do not auto-convert to NOT_APPLICABLE.
Check whether this is a queue position, prerequisite or agent allocation.
Recompute from source-backed clock events; do not inherit a date-free overdue label.

implementation_notes: Use HELD_PENDING_OWNER_DECISION with separate cost/authority fields for a route not pursued because a fee or owner approval is outstanding; never map that route to NOT_APPLICABLE or UNAVAILABLE.
